newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yoshitomi, Green Cross shares lose further ground.
newsitem.headline: Yoshitomi, Green Cross shares lose further ground.

text.p: Shares in Yoshitomi Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd and Green Cross Corp continued to lose ground on Wednesday on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Yoshitomi shares were down 16 yen at 806 yen at 0054 GMT, while Green Cross shares were down 18 yen at 502 yen at 0055 GMT.
Osaka-based drug makers Yoshitomi and Green Cross announced on Monday that they would merge on October 1.

Green Cross has been at the centre of a scandal concerning HIV-tainted blood products which led to indictment last October of three former Green Cross presidents on charges of professional negligence.
The company faces compensation payments totalling about 24 billion yen to people who were infected with HIV through the use of its blood products.

The two companies nevertheless stressed the bright side of the merger at a news conference held on Monday, saying that the new company would be able to compete with top Japanese drug makers in the international arena.
